name: Jumli
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Sinjapati, R. B. 1994 [2050 VS]. Jumli Bhasikako Barnanatmak Adhyan [Descriptive study of the Jumli dialect] (Nepali-language description; not online); also Pandit & Adhikari 2014 SIL survey (sil.org 403).

sources.citation: Nepalese Linguistics vols 23-34 (2008-2019), a full-text search for stress/accent Jumli/Sinjali/Sijali/Jumleli (Digital Himalaya PDFs; vols 16-22 are image scans without text layer, not scanned).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No Jumli article in any volume; hits are lists only (vol 27: 'Jumli, a dialect of Nepali, shows ergative verb agreement'; vol 28: census tables; vol 32: language list; vol 25: 'Sanskrit and Sinjali' inscriptions).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1, languoid juml1238 (Jumli): four descriptive refs (Sinjapati 1981/1985/1994; Bandhu 1984).
sources.note: Bibliographic only; none of the four refs has a URL/DOI; our access cache (HathiTrust, IA, OpenAlex, the Harvard library catalogue) found none of them.

sources.citation: Acharya, Omprakash (ओमप्रकाश आचार्य). 2024 [2081 VS]. सिँजाली खस भाषाको वर्णव्यवस्था [The phonological system of Sinjali Khas]. Shabda Sadhana (शब्दसाधना) 7(1): 145-165. DOI 10.3126/shabdasadhana.v7i1.75099 (Nepali).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Names बलाघात (stress) as one of the contrastive suprasegmentals (p. 147, p. 161, abstract p. 145) and in the conclusion (p. 164) says Sinjali 'has its own arrangement' of length, nasality, rhythm and stress; but the suprasegmental section (pp. 161-164) treats only length, nasality, juncture/pause, breathiness and rhythm - there is no stress subsection, no rule, no example, no placement statement.

sources.citation: Acharya, Omprakash. 2024. जुम्ली खस भाषामा रूपायन व्यवस्था [Morphological system in Jumli Khas]. Journal of Durgalaxmi 3(1): 290-305. DOI 10.3126/jdl.v3i1.73861 (Nepali).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; morphology (noun/pronoun/adjective inflection) only; a full-text search for stress/accent बलाघात/स्वराघात empty.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Jumli language' and (ne) 'जुम्ली भाषा', with their references (Language Commission Nepal 2022 orthography: 24 vowel and 41 consonant characters; news items on the Khasiya Akhar dictionary and 2022 documentation drive).
sources.note: Nothing on stress; no phonological description beyond inventory counts.

sources.citation: archive.org item JMLMTTSNA, Jumli Translation Committee 2020, audio Bible (Genesis-Acts) in Jumli.
Hale, Austin. 2019. Reflections on the beginnings of linguistics at Tribhuvan University. Nepalese Linguistics 34 (whole volume PDF, Digital Himalaya), mention on p. 89.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; bibliographic evidence only: 'On the 23rd of December 1970, C. M. Bandhu showed us his paper, Sinjali Phonemic Summary' (p. 89) - attests an unpublished c.1970 phonemic summary of Sinjali (= Jumli).

sources.citation: Acharya, Omprakash. 2018. जुम्ली भाषाको वाक्यमा कालगत (पक्ष) व्यवस्था [Tense/aspect in Jumli sentences]. Spandan 2(1). DOI 10.3126/spandan.v2i1.63444 (Nepali).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; tense/aspect only; abstract only says Jumli verb structure differs from Nepali 'phonetically'.
